title: Sixtus Quintus
summary: Raleigh names Sixtus Quintus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Sixtus Quintus the Pope, who told a Frier that had he seene by what folly this world is gouerned, he would wonder at nothing. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXI, §. VI, sig. 323b
